title: Credit’s Lair
tagline: A brave knight. A very long contract. A dragon with expensive taste.
description: Watch the danger, make your move, and survive the golden offer.
disclaimer: Fictional coins and contract terms. An educational story, not financial advice.

beats.cue: Stone on the right. Dodge left!

text.kicker: A close call. On to the merchant.
text.title: Nicely played.
text.body: Look before you leap. A moment of attention can save a costly mistake.

text.title: Wrong turn. The gate gets the last word.
text.body: Watch the danger and choose a different move. Your checkpoint is right here.

beats.cue: 600 outright. Or 100 + six payments of 120. Inspect first!

text.kicker: Fine print read. Paper trap avoided.
text.title: Nicely played.
text.body: 100 + (6 × 120) = 820 coins. That is 220 more than the 600-coin price. You kept your old armor and all 1,000 coins.

text.title: You got wrapped up in the offer.

beats.cue: Watch the dragon. Duck below the flame!

text.kicker: Flame dodged. The vault is yours.
text.title: You earned your gold.
text.body: You protected your reserve and earned 400 coins. Final purse: 1,400. In this fictional quest, keeping a cushion beat buying the shiny upgrade.

text.title: A bold strategy. A lightly toasted result.

text.title: Rich in gold. Richer in judgment.
text.body: Three rooms survived. You kept 1,000 coins, avoided the 820-coin contract, and earned 400 more. Final purse: 1,400 coins.
